You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Which category does a safety component with self-evolving behaviour based on machine learning fall under?

Facts:
[0] safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour — listedIn — Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour (annex I part A point 5) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 5]
[1] machinery with embedded self-evolving ML systems ensuring safety functions — listedIn — 6. (annex I, part A, point 6) [condition: in respect only of those systems] [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 6]
[2] self-evolving machinery — requiresMeasure — adapting machinery or a related product (adapting machinery or a related product) [condition: where relevant] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.6]
[3] Autonomous mobile machinery — definedAs — has an autonomous mode (has an autonomous mode) [condition: all essential safety functions ensured without permanent interaction of an operator] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[4] autonomous mobile machinery — requiresMeasure — devices intended to detect any human, domestic animal or any other obstacle in its vicinity (devices intended to detect any human, domestic animal or any other obstacle in its vicinity) [condition: where those obstacles could give rise to a risk to the health and safety of persons or domestic animals or to the safe operation of the machinery or related product] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[5] safety component — definedAs — ‘safety component’ means a physical or digital component (‘safety component’ means a physical or digital component) [condition: but which is not necessary in order for that product to function or for which normal components may be substituted in order for that product to function] [REG, Art. 3(3)]
[6] autonomous mobile machinery — requiresMeasure — an enclosed zone fitted with a peripheral protection system comprising guards or protective devices (an enclosed zone fitted with a peripheral protection system comprising guards or protective devices) [condition: with one or both where necessary according to the risk assessment] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[7] autonomous mobile machinery — requiresMeasure — supervisory function specific to the autonomous mode (supervisory function specific to the autonomous mode) [condition: Where relevant] [REG, Annex III, 3.2.4]
[8] 2.3(d) non-fully automated machine — addressesRisk — risk of accidental injury (risk of accidental injury) [condition: where the tool is incorporated into a non-fully automated machine] [DIR, Annex I, 2.3]
[9] category of machinery or related product — listedIn — Annex I, Part A (annex i, part a) [condition: if, according to the assessment referred to in paragraph 4, and taking into account the available information, it presents a serious inherent potential risk, and one or more of the following conditions is fulfilled] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[10] control system — requiresMeasure — designed to perform the safety functions by itself (designed to perform the safety functions by itself) [condition: For autonomous mobile machinery or related product; even when actions are ordered by using a remote supervisory function] [REG, Annex III, 3.3]
[11] control systems for pedestrian-controlled machinery — addressesRisk — inadvertent movement of the machinery towards the driver (inadvertent movement of the machinery towards the driver) [REG, Annex III, 3.3.4]
[12] machinery with collision risk — requiresMeasure — fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided (fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided) [condition: where several fixed or rail-mounted machines can be manoeuvred simultaneously in the same place, with risks of collision] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.6]
[13] non-fully automated machinery with incorporated tool — addressesRisk — risk of accidental injury (risk of accidental injury) [condition: where the tool is incorporated into non-fully automated machinery or a related product] [REG, Annex III, 2.3]
[14] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) (conformity based on full quality assurance (module h)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[15] essential requirement 1.7.1.2 (warning devices) — addressesRisk — a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery (a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery) [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.1.2]
[16] remote-controlled machinery — requiresMeasure — devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately (devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately) [condition: if the driver loses control, if it receives a stop signal, if a fault is detected in a safety-related part of the system, if no validation signal is detected within a specified time] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.3]
[17] Machinery or related products presenting risks due to their mobility — definedAs — operatedwithout being moved (operatedwithout being moved) [condition: machinery operated without being moved but which may be equipped to be moved more easily] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[18] autonomous mobile machinery or related products — mustAccompany — instructions for use (instructions for use) [REG, Annex III, 3.6.3.3]
[19] Machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility — definedAs — Machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility (machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility) [DIR, Annex I, 3.1.1]
[20] safety component — definedAs — means a component (means a component) [condition: which is independently placed on the market] [DIR, Art. 2]
[21] Machinery or related products presenting risks due to their mobility — definedAs — requires either mobility while working (requires either mobility while working) [condition: the operation requires mobility while working, or continuous or semi continuous movement between fixed working locations] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[22] automatic-charging batteries of mobile machinery — addressesRisk — hazards referred to in sections 1.3.8.2 and 1.5.1 (hazards referred to in sections 1.3.8.2 and 1.5.1) [condition: when the machinery or related product moves autonomously to the charging station] [REG, Annex III, 3.5.1]
[23] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) (conformity based on full quality assurance (module h)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[24] indicative list of safety components — listedIn — Annex II (annex II) [condition: in the light of technical progress and knowledge or new scientific evidence] [REG, Art. 7(2)]
[25] control systems, safety and reliability — addressesRisk — hazardous situations (hazardous situations) [DIR, Annex I, 1.2.1]
[26] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) (conformity based on unit verification (module g)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[27] 1.3.7 moving parts — requiresMeasure — guards or protective devices (guards or protective devices) [condition: where risks persist] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.7]
[28] movement of machinery depending on safe positioning of parts — requiresMeasure — movement of the machinery shall depend on safe positioning (movement of the machinery shall depend on safe positioning) [condition: where it does not give rise to other risks] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.2]
[29] starting in automatic mode — addressesRisk — hazardous situation (hazardous situation) [condition: provided this does not lead to a hazardous situation] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.3]
